items.context: @CryptoLifer33 (42.696 seguidores, en inglés): dice que Lyn Alden publicó "Bitcoin is dead" en el aniversario exacto de su llamado de 2022, que ese día marcó el piso de $15,6k y luego vino un 8x, y que con un drawdown de 56% en este ciclo vuelve la misma frase; sugiere que una ironía así suele aparecer cerca del giro. ~1 h 52 min, 1.207 vistas, 18 likes y solo 1 respuesta: cuenta mediana con un post sobre drawdowns y casi sin respuestas, que se responde con los datos del Cycle Clock y del Drawdown Atlas.
items.suggested_text:
Worth putting that 56% in context. In the Bitcoin Cycle Clock I put together, the 2011 drawdown reached -92.7% and took 622 days to reclaim the prior high; the 2013 one hit -84.5% and needed 1,177 days. The deepest drops have been getting shallower as the holder base widens and the market gets more liquid.

"Bitcoin is dead" lines tend to show up where the pain peaks, which isn't always where the chart bottoms. A 56% drawdown on a much larger asset wipes out more absolute wealth than -92% did in 2011, so it can feel worse even when it's milder.

Depth is only half the story, though. In 2013 two similar peaks took 210 and 1,177 days to recover, and this cycle hasn't told us yet which kind it is.
